releases.notes:
## First public release

No More Gap lets compatible Minecraft blocks share the same block space, enabling denser and more detailed builds.

### Highlights

- Place carpets and snow layers at the feet of plants, torches, doors, and similar blocks.
- Combine up to 64 compatible parts in one composite block.
- Interact with, select, and break individual parts.
- Support for waterlogging, lava logging, and lava/water obsidian reactions.
- Redstone, doors, trapdoors, gates, lamps, and bulbs work inside composites.
- Optional snowy-vegetation world generation in cold biomes.
- Configuration file and gamerules for composite limits and lava reactions.

### Compatibility

- Fabric mod.
- Builds are included for Minecraft 1.21 through 1.21.11.
- A separate build is available for Minecraft 26.1.2.
- Requires Fabric API and installation on both client and server.

> This is an experimental first release. Please back up worlds before using it in an important save.

readmeSummary: No More Gap is an experimental Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.1.2 that allows several blocks to occupy the same space.
